# Register-ZbxAgentHandler

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that answers an item key on a running agent session.

## SYNTAX

### Direct (Default)

```
Register-ZbxAgentHandler [-Name] <string> [-Key] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### Binding

```
Register-ZbxAgentHandler [-Name] <string> [-Binding] <ZabbixAgentHandlerBinding> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxAgentHandler cmdlet adds a handler to the active or passive agent session named in -Name: a scriptblock that answers -Key, run on the session's own runspace with the parsed key as its argument; its last output, as text, is the value. It works on either kind of session; Register-ZbxActiveAgentHandler and Register-ZbxPassiveAgentHandler do the same for one kind and refuse the other. A binding from New-ZbxAgentHandler can be piped in instead of -Key and -ScriptBlock.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Answer a key on a passive agent

```powershell
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Port 30150
Register-ZbxAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent' -Key 'app.health' -ScriptBlock { 'ok' }
Get-ZbxAgentItem -Agent '127.0.0.1:30150' -Key 'app.health' | Select-Object Key, Value
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
```

The handler's argument is the key; Parameters holds its parameters, here none.

### Example 2: Answer a key with parameters

```powershell
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Port 30150
Register-ZbxAgentHandler -Name 'web-agent' -Key 'app.queue' -ScriptBlock {
    param($key)
    @{ orders = 12; mail = 0 }[$key.Parameters[0]]
}
Get-ZbxAgentItem -Agent '127.0.0.1:30150' -Key 'app.queue[orders]' | Select-Object Key, Value
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
```

app.queue[orders] reaches the handler as a key whose Parameters[0] is orders.

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixAgentHandlerBinding`: Bound to -Binding (ByValue). One key/scriptblock binding built by New-ZbxAgentHandler, for piping into the Register-Zbx*AgentHandler commands.

## OUTPUTS
